The '''Westwater Settlements''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] that occupied one of the planet's mesas. It included the [[Farend Cantina]] and the [[Kinlo Plantation]], and [[Tyvar]]'s family lived in the area. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the [[InterStellar Regulators]] deployed [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertanks]] and additional forces in an attempt to pacify the settlement.<ref name="Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />
